requires: Integrated full verification and root explicit paired timing lease.

comparisonDisposition.absoluteGates: Evaluate and report original eight numerical limits for both B0 and C in both orders.
comparisonDisposition.candidateRequired: C must pass 8/8 original limits in each order.
comparisonDisposition.baselineNumericalMiss: Preserve failed_budget; numerical miss alone does not stop the remaining authorized arm.
comparisonDisposition.fatalComparisonFailure: Stop and preserve identity, typed-oracle or lifecycle disagreement in either arm.
comparisonDisposition.relativeReview: Report pairwise QPS, fixed/mixed p50/p99, ACK count/rate and sampled RSS deltas with absolute values, order and pins. No new relative hard gate.
comparisonDisposition.thresholds: No post-hoc threshold changes or first-outcome retry.
